title: 53 Hispanic students enrolled at Stratford Avenue School for 2025-26
text:
Stratford Avenue School had 53 Hispanic students enrolled during the 2025-26 school year, marking a 3.9% increase compared to the previous year, the New York State Education Department reports.
Enrollment data indicated the school’s student body for 2025-26 totaled 642 students. Hispanic students made up 8.3% of that group, making them the third-largest ethnic group represented.
Located within the Garden City Union Free School District, the school’s central office can be found in Garden City.
Of the seven district schools, Garden City Middle School had the most Hispanic students during this period, enrolling 82 in total.
New York holds the second-highest ranking nationwide for K-12 public education spending , spending an average of $30,012 per student, nearly double the national rate of $16,526, according to data from the Education Data Initiative.
